basis: M9 coupled plant, M10 causal state-estimation interfaces, user-confirmed GW supply scale

tasks.objective: Check workload and revisit feasibility before optimizing priorities
deliverables: Fleet size, zoning and per-task revisit targets
Which calibrated remote sensors can satisfy which tasks
tasks.gate: Do not promise full coverage or deadlines under an infeasible resource budget; examples are synthetic lower bounds, not site staffing

tasks.objective: Freeze the task decision, public risk proxy and completion semantics
deliverables: Task catalogue with equipment, profession, access, travel and service duration
Inspection age and model disagreement for active checking
Separate estimator alerts from qualified confirmed discoveries
tasks.gate: No true severity or injected fault label in actor input; inspection alone does not repair the plant

tasks.objective: Build a representative aisle and asynchronous task environment
deliverables: Passable aisle graph and rack approach points
Professional action masks and completion events
Physical-time accounting shared by all methods
tasks.gate: Recheck blocked access, ineligible assignments, travel/service timing and unfinished tasks; synthetic layout clearly identified

tasks.objective: Compare static cycles, revisit urgency, risk greediness, rolling planning and retrained learning policies
deliverables: Common available observations and time budget
Keep nominal physics and history-CVAE controls; select tools using validation and hotspot recall
New matched policy training budgets and validation-only selection
Independent test seeds, combinations and scale tiers
Report rare local faults separately from whole-facility dilution
tasks.gate: M8 weights and percentages are historical controls, not new-domain performance; no arbitrary new topology claim

tasks.objective: Test whether estimation accuracy translates to inspection benefit
metrics: Revisit overdue rate and maximum waiting
Unserved IT demand and controller state reported separately
tasks.gate: Report tradeoffs and failure cases; do not call information freshness repaired physical risk

later_M12.objective: Introduce fixed open-model proposals for skills, tool use and collaboration workflows
later_M12.gate: Freeze plant and holdout evaluator first; distinguish workflow improvement from demonstrated recursive improver improvement
